game_concept_merit_desc:
A [character_possessive|E] $game_concept_merit$ tracks their progress to the next [merit_level|E]. All characters with an [elder|E] or [disciples|E] produce a passive $game_concept_merit$ gain.

[governors|E] can increase their $game_concept_merit$ by constructing [buildings|E] in their assigned [holdings|E], going on an [inspection|E] [activity|E], participating in a [GetActivityType('activity_debate').GetName] and attending [examinations|E].

[GetSubjectContractType( 'celestial_provinces' ).GetObligationNameShort( 'celestial_province_standard' )] governors increase their monthly merit gain by paying more [taxes|E] to their [liege|E], while [GetSubjectContractType( 'celestial_provinces' ).GetObligationNameShort( 'celestial_province_military' )] governors increase it by creating [men_at_arms|E].

Non-$game_concept_governors$ can attempt to increase it by attending [examinations|E].
game_concept_merit_level_desc:
A [character_possessive|E] $game_concept_merit_level$ indicates how appropriate they are as a [governor|E] in East Asian [administrative_governments|E].

It represents their documented achievements and moral conduct according to Confucian ideals through the amount of [merit|E] they have gained.

An official with a high $game_concept_merit_level$ has a higher [candidate_score|E] and [governor_salary|E].

The Ranks are:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_0' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_1' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_2' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_3' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_4' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_5' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_6' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_7' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_8' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[GetModifier( 'merit_level_9' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L]
game_concept_imperial_examination_desc:
The $game_concept_imperial_examinations$ hold a key role in the [government_bureaucratic_type|E] functions of [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName|E] and [GetGovernment('meritocratic_government').GetName|E] [governments|E]. 

Through the examination system, bureaucrats are appointed by [merit|E] over lineage, ensuring that the brightest scholars, regardless of heritage, may gain [governorship|E] appointments. 

The examination levels are: 
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Children's#!: Parents can have their children take the examination from the age of [EmptyScope.ScriptValue('child_exam_min_age')] through the $send_child_to_examination_interaction$ [interaction|E].#! 
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Provincial#!: Characters who are not [landed|E] may attempt the second level of Examinations through the [GetActivityType('activity_local_examination').GetName] [activity|E].#! 
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Metropolitan#!: Held by the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName|E] [government|E] through the [GetActivityType('activity_imperial_examination').GetName] activity.#! 
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Palace#!: The final [EmptyScope.ScriptValue('metropolitan_exam_final_entrants_loc')] entrants at the $activity_imperial_examination$ are invited to a feast at the royal palace, to meet and show their worth to the [son_of_heaven|E].#!
game_concept_provincial_examination_desc:
The second level [imperial_examinations|E], taken via the [GetActivityType('activity_local_examination').GetName] [activity|E].

#S When passed:#!
[GetModifier( 'tgp_passed_provincial_exam_modifier' ).GetDescWithEffects].
game_concept_metropolitan_examination_de:
The third level [imperial_examinations|E]. Held by the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName|E] [government|E] through the [GetActivityType('activity_imperial_examination').GetName] [activity|E].

#S When passed:#!
[GetModifier( 'tgp_passed_metropolitan_exam_modifier' ).GetDescWithEffects].
game_concept_palace_examination_desc:
The fourth and final [imperial_examinations|E]. The final [EmptyScope.ScriptValue('metropolitan_exam_final_entrants_loc')] entrants at the [GetActivityType('activity_imperial_examination').GetName] are invited to a feast at the royal palace, to kowtow and show their worth to the [son_of_heaven|E].

#S When passed:#!
[GetModifier( 'tgp_passed_palace_exam_modifier' ).GetDescWithEffects].
game_concept_merit_pool_desc:
A $game_concept_merit_pool$ contains all potential [characters|E] who are eligible to gain [titles|E] with certain types of [appointment|E].

Candidates are sorted based on their [candidate_score|E]. Some [appointment_succession_laws|E] use [merit|E], which will sort the candidates by their [merit_level|E] first and $game_concept_candidate_score$ second.

When the [holder|E] of a Title with $game_concept_appointment$ dies, the Title will pass to the highest ranking character in the list. If the character holds a Title already, the Title must have higher a higher [appointment_prominence|E], otherwise it will pass to the next character.

celestial_government_merit_level_3_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: To attain this rank, scholars are expected to have completed the [provincial_examination|E]. Proceeding to [GetModifier( 'merit_level_4' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L] requires passing higher level [examinations|E].
celestial_government_merit_level_4_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: To attain this rank, scholars are expected to have completed the [provincial_examination|E]. Proceeding to [GetModifier( 'merit_level_5' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L] requires passing the [metropolitan_examination|E].
celestial_government_merit_level_5_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: Officials at this [merit_level|E] are expected to have completed the [metropolitan_examination|E]. The next rank is [GetModifier( 'merit_level_6' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L].
celestial_government_merit_level_6_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: Officials at this rank are required to have completed the [metropolitan_examination|E]. The next rank is [GetModifier( 'merit_level_7' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L].
celestial_government_merit_level_7_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: Officials of this rank are expected to have completed the [palace_examination|E]. The next rank is [GetModifier( 'merit_level_8' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L].
celestial_government_merit_level_8_descr: \n\nFor the [GetGovernment('celestial_government').GetName] [government|E]: Officials of this rank are expected to have completed the [palace_examination|E]. The next rank is [GetModifier( 'merit_level_9' ).GetNameWithTooltip|L].
